subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+16

- PC volume/brightness: buttons in the shared box, slider grows from the button
  - "volume" and "brightness" are normal buttons in the bar's button group (ids in the bottom controls layout; PC only; added at the start of the right side until the settings place or hide them).
  - Hover: the button's own box swells 4 px on every side, then grows up 150 px with the slider inside; one timeline with per-part easing, so leaving plays the same path backwards and ends exactly as the hovered button looks (no jump).
  - Settings → Player → Bottom controls lists Volume and Brightness (PC).
